title: Decide sync engine: PowerSync vs Automerge
description: PowerSync (SQLite<->Postgres, first-class Swift + web SDKs, self-hostable, last-write-wins per row) vs Automerge (CRDT, native Swift, merge-always). Recommendation: PowerSync for SQL-native model + existing Swift/web SDKs and self-hostable backend that the Mini agent can share. Pick Automerge only if true concurrent multi-device edits of the same task are common.
close_reason: PowerSync selected: SQLite<->Postgres local-first (instant optimistic local writes = capture speed), native Swift + web SDKs, self-hostable, shareable by the Mini agent.

title: Scaffold native UIKit (iOS) + AppKit (macOS) app with PowerSync Swift SDK
description: Native Swift apps using UIKit on iOS and AppKit on macOS (NO SwiftUI requirement, NO JS-wrapped frameworks like React Native/Capacitor). Performance is the priority: native rendering, instant capture. Integrate powersync-ja/powersync-swift (native Swift SDK, not the JS bundle). Share core capture/sync logic in a Swift package; thin UIKit/AppKit view layers per platform. List + capture views.
close_reason: Native UIKit (iOS) + AppKit (macOS) scaffolded on a shared CaptureCore Swift package + PowerSync Swift SDK. macOS app builds; end-to-end native data path verified via CaptureProbe (capture->suggest->confirm->Postgres). iOS code-complete (full compile needs iOS sim platform).
